question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated as a kite-flying festival across India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Makar Sankranti.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Makar Sankranti:

 
 
• It is celebrated in January every year and marks the end of the Winter season and the beginning of a new harvest season.
 
• The festival is dedicated to Lord Sun.
 
• On this day, the sun enters the zodiac sign of Capricorn or Makar which marks the end of winter months and the beginning of longer days.
 
 
 
• In different parts of the country, Makar Sankranti is celebrated by different names:
 
 
• Lohri: Celebrated in Haryana and Punjab one day before Makar Sankranti.
 
• Khichdi: Celebrated in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Pongal: Tamil Nadu
 
• Kite Festival: Gujarat.
